question: Where should Pārvatī and the form of Śiva be visualized in the body?
premises: Pārvatī is to be visualized in the heart.
The form of Śiva is to be visualized on the head.
The verse assigns distinct bodily loci to each.
inference: Therefore one should visualize Goddess Pārvatī in the heart and the form of Śiva on the head.
plain_english: One should visualize Goddess Pārvatī in the heart and the form of Śiva on the head.
